import RegistrationAuditedLifetimeWitnessExecution

/-! Intentionally false on the baseline. This private diagnostic is compiled only
against the final-Register omission, after its fresh legal execution module. The
mutation is handwritten-model fault injection, not a production Rust defect. -/
namespace RegistrationAuditedLifetime.Witnesses
open RegistrationAuditedLifetime
open RegistrationTransaction (put)

/-- Independently spelled complete wrong ledger: both ended records and the
unrelated prior record remain, but no candidate Register record exists. -/
def missingRegisterAudit : Audit := fun id =>
  if id = 100 then some replaceFirst else if id = 101 then some replaceSecond
  else if id = 900 then some priorRecord else none
def missingRegisterCursor : Cursor String Draft Nat :=
  ⟨[⟨.replace, oldServer⟩, ⟨.replace, oldServer⟩], [], [replaceFirst, replaceSecond]⟩

theorem missing_register_ledger : acknowledged.audit = missingRegisterAudit := by
  change overlay encoding priorAudit [replaceFirst, replaceSecond] = missingRegisterAudit
  funext id
  by_cases first : id = 100
  · subst id
    rfl
  by_cases second : id = 101
  · subst id
    rfl
  simp [overlay, encoding, replaceFirst, replaceSecond, priorAudit, missingRegisterAudit,
    put, first, second]

theorem missing_register_slot : acknowledged.audit 102 = none := by
  rfl

/-- The same unchanged complete acceptance predicate is refuted by its ledger
clause, using actual absence versus its independently specified complete record. -/
theorem missing_register_refutes_acceptance : ¬ReplacementAccepted := by
  intro accepted
  have slot := congrFun accepted.2.1 102
  rw [missing_register_slot] at slot
  change none = some registerRecord at slot
  cases slot

def MissingRegisterOutcome : Prop :=
  acknowledged.core.db = expectedDB ∧ acknowledged.audit = missingRegisterAudit ∧
    (acknowledged.core.transactions 0).request = .register proposal ∧
    (acknowledged.core.transactions 0).phase = .committed ∧
    (acknowledged.core.transactions 0).response = .registered ∧
    acknowledged.core.instanceOwner = none ∧ acknowledged.core.deploymentOwner = none ∧
    acknowledged.core.commits =
      [(0, [.upsertDeployment newMetadata "unused-first-deployment-value",
        .registration (.deleteRows [30, 31]), .registration (.dropLogin 40), .registration (.dropLogin 41),
        .registration (.createLogin 20 "new-registration-role"), .registration (.insert candidate)])] ∧
    acknowledged.cursors 0 = some missingRegisterCursor ∧
    acknowledged.audit 102 = none ∧
    (cursor3.acknowledged.map (recordIntent encoding)).count ⟨.replace, oldServer⟩ = 2 ∧
    (cursor3.acknowledged.map (recordIntent encoding)).count ⟨.register, newServer⟩ = 0 ∧
    ¬ReplacementAccepted

/-- Legal modified execution, unchanged complete admitted data and store success,
plus the complete wrong audit output. No assumed desired after-state or success
is used: execution/data are proved in the freshly compiled mutated path module. -/
theorem missing_register_complete :
    Execution source encoding start acknowledged ∧ MissingRegisterOutcome := by
  refine ⟨replacement_execution, replacement_database, missing_register_ledger,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, missing_register_slot,
    ?_, ?_, missing_register_refutes_acceptance⟩
  all_goals decide

#print axioms missing_register_ledger
#print axioms missing_register_refutes_acceptance
#print axioms missing_register_complete

run_cmd do
  let allowed := #[``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]
  for declaration in #[``missing_register_ledger, ``missing_register_slot,
      ``missing_register_refutes_acceptance, ``MissingRegisterOutcome, ``missing_register_complete] do
    let found ← Lean.collectAxioms declaration
    let unexpected := found.filter (fun name => !allowed.contains name)
    unless unexpected.isEmpty do
      throwError "unexpected missing-Register diagnostic axiom in {declaration}: {unexpected}"

end RegistrationAuditedLifetime.Witnesses
